description: This file provides an implementation for a 'delete' function within a pipeline framework, specifically as a part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines a class `PipelineFunctionDelete` that implements the `PipelineFunction` interface, encapsulating the logic to validate parameters and produce a 'deleted' pipeline element when invoked.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionDelete
classes.description: An immutable class implementing a delete function within a pipeline, providing function name, signature, and application logic for the delete operation.

classes.name: DeleteFunctionSignature
classes.description: A singleton class defining the parameterless signature of the delete function.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function, which is 'delete'.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature object of the delete function, which has no parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the delete function logic, validating parameters and returning a 'deleted' pipeline element.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates that the parameters string is empty (no parameters allowed), throws exception if invalid.
